name: bos
description: Break of Structure: buys when a candle closes above the last swing high in an uptrend. Stop under the last swing low, target a set reward-to-risk, trailing stop to ride the move.
author: bb-cli

swing.describe: candles on each side that make a swing high/low

trend.describe: EMA that must be below the price (uptrend filter)

maxRiskAtr.describe: skip when the swing low is more than this many ATRs away

slAtr.describe: stop this many ATRs under the swing low
